notes.title: Assault Android Cactus+
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5074127/c77abeacb13adc1df74a0f5869339e98e1ef3b7c.jpg[/img]
In our biggest update since leaving Early Access in 2015, Assault Android Cactus has been upgraded with [b]Campaign+[/b], new costumes and a new aiming mode. To mark the occasion, [b]Assault Android Cactus+[/b] will be on sale, then move to a higher price point when the sale ends.

[h1]Campaign+[/h1]
Each stage has been rebuilt with new enemy waves and dynamic elements, utilizing the game's full arsenal of enemies for new encounters and amped up boss fights. More than just a hard mode, [b]Campaign+[/b] is meant to give accomplished players a new experience, new leaderboards to climb and a fresh challenge for couch co-op players.

[h1]New Costumes[/h1]
Beat stages with each Android to unlock a new look!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5074127/778ecd8554644222efe35ac9a557e6088213df98.png[/img]

[h1]Automatic Aim[/h1]
Included under Accessibility Options, enabling [b]Automatic Aim[/b] will take care of aiming when you don't use the right stick or the mouse, letting players concentrate on dodging and using weapons effectively.

Preserving the core of the Cactus experience while reducing complexity, this is a game mode we think will appeal to those who struggle with the controls or anyone who wants to give their thumb a rest. The opt-in nature also makes it ideal for couch co-op sessions that involve players of different skill levels.

[h1]Other Changes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Movie Gallery[/b] under [b]Collections[/b] for reviewing cutscenes
[*]Selecting an Androids costume is remembered and can be used for AI team members and cutscenes viewed through the [b]Movie Gallery[/b]
[*]On knockdown, hold any button to Revive, at a slightly slower rate than tapping
[*]Added [b]Revive Assist[/b] to [b]Accessibility Options[/b] which will revive downed players without controller input (at a slower rate than tapping or holding)
[*][b]Fingerstyle+[/b], the new version of the Android Select / Stage Select song for Campaign+ is in the jukebox and added to the Soundtrack DLC
[*]Animated Cactus silhouette on the loading screen is fun to watch
[*]Too many fixes, improvements and adjustments to list
[/list]

[h1]Sale and incoming Price Increase[/h1]
To celebrate [b]Assault Android Cactus+[/b] on Steam we are going on sale on the 30th! If you're considering picking up the game make sure you wait until we're 50% off!

Not only is it a great price to grab the game at, once this sale is over we will be taking the unusual step of increasing the price. With the many improvements and features we've added over the years, and now [b]Campaign+[/b], we believe [b]AAC+[/b] is just a different and better game than what we released in 2015 and we want the price to reflect that. [b]If you already own the game you are just receiving a free update[/b], but we have given this a lot of thought and decided that this was the fairest way to bring content that was originally made for our Nintendo Switch release back to the PC.

We hope you understand our reasoning and if you've been on the fence about buying the game, that you consider grabbing it while discounted!

notes.title: Mini Update
notes.content:
You may have noticed Assault Android Cactus updating a few times since the last update - after such a long gap we ended up having a few issues that weren't caught in testing. We think we're done now though and thank you for your patience!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]FXAA graphics option
[*]Boss spawns in the Campaign
[*]Lemon's rockets against Medulla's last form
[*]Weird issue that could leave a single Wasp unresponsive
[*]Missing audio in post credits scene
[/list]

[h1]End of DX9 support[/h1]
as mentioned in the previous update, due to game engine updates we no longer support DX9 on Windows, only DX11 and OpenGL.

For anyone inconvenienced by this, you can continue using the previous build of the game by right clicking and choosing [b]Properties[/b] > [b]Betas[/b] and selecting [b]Legacy[/b] from the dropdown menu.

notes.title: Balance Improvements and Developer Commentary
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5074127/3982669324e8dc1764eb5de5cfbfcd8d87bd2cdf.jpg[/img]

This update incorporates the beneficial changes and bug fixes that had occurred elsewhere since our last Steam release.

In collaboration with feedback from some of our most dedicated players, we've given the Androids a tuning pass and overall higher scores can now be obtained, so attack those leaderboards anew!

We have also added a [b]Developer Commentary mode[/b]! Enabled via Audio Options in the Main Menu, you can now play through the campaign while hearing the three of us reminisce and shed light on the AAC development process.

[h1]Changes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]The majority of Androids have received buffs to their Primary and Secondary weapons
[*][b]Lemon[/b] and [b]Liquorice[/b] have received small increases to their Secondary AOE's
[*]The window for triggering the [b]multi-kill bonus[/b] ('surge' bonus) has been increased, allowing it to be utilised by more characters under more circumstances
[*]The [b]Time Bonus[/b] in campaign levels has been increased
[*][b]Developer Commentary[/b] can be enabled via the [b]Options[/b] > [b]Audio[/b] menu
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reinstated the Battery collection screen edge effect
[*]Layer 37 of [b]Infinity Drive[/b] has been made less mean
[*]In [b]Boss Rush[/b], dying bosses no longer delay the spawn of the next boss
[*]Improved enemy behaviour on [b]Centrifuge[/b] (zone 5 - 1)
[*]Many small improvements, fixes and tweaks
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]DX9 support has been dropped - this may impact users of older Windows operating systems
[/list]

notes.content:

[h1]Changes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]

[*]Fixed shadow projection issues on Zone 4 Boss [b]Venom[/b] stage
[*]Improved/consistant lighting on the background Genki Star in all [b]Zone 4[/b] levels
[*]Fixed the transition effect at the end of the Final Boss [b]Medulla[/b] fight to slide under particles/effects as intended
[*]Fixed mouse controls not correctly driving volume sliders on Main Menu

[*]Esc key now backs out of [b]Leaderboards[/b] in Main Menu (consistent with other menus)
[/list]

notes.title: Cactus kicks butt with a Steam Controller
notes.content:
[h1]We're part of this weekend's sale for [b]Big Picture-Friendly Games[/b][/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/sale/bigpicturegames/

Not only does Cactus work great with Big Picture mode, we've been a good fit for the Steam Controller from the beginning - you may remember our unexpected appearance in Valve's announcement trailer at around the minute mark
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8fs2Yh1PFwM
One cool thing about the Steam Controller is it can be customised, by anyone, and thanks to improvements made by [b]HERO 01[/b], we now have two Recommend configurations which can be reached by choosing [b]Manage Game[/b] and looking for the [b]Controller Configuration[/b] option.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5074127/dd863b29842e648a75ca7b6a4af7105e4da8c62a.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]AAC Gamepad Aiming[/b] emulates a gamepad and is the easiest to get up and playing with, particularly for local multiplayer! Be sure to let your thumbs trace big easy circles towards the edge of the trackpad surfaces to get the full aiming accuracy the Steam Controller is capable of.

[*][b]AAC Mouse Region Aiming[/b] emulates Mouse and Keyboard and suited for players with a bit of experience. The right trackpad positions the aiming reticle directly, allowing for lightning fast adjustments and precision Helo movements. If you have a Steam Controller, give it a go as it's a fun and new way to play!
[/list]

We've put these two profiles under Recommended to to make them easy to find and use, but take a peek in the Community section to see what other people have come up with!

notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update1_1.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Soundtrack[/b] now includes FLAC - anyone with this DLC will find an additional directory inside their game directory
[*][b]Credits[/b] are now earned on [b]Battery Depleted[/b] (stage loss) during the campaign and when restarting / quitting stages
[*][b]Credit earning rate[/b] has increased slightly
[*][i](Windows / OSX)[/i] [b]Gamepad disconnection detection[/b] - the game will attempt to pause and offer a chance to reconnect the controller or migrate to a new control device
[*]In co-op, if a player other than Player 1 pauses the game, the pause menu will say who it is so you can yell at them to unpause the game and keep playing
[*]added an [b]Accessibility[/b] menu under [b]Options[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Fire Mode[/b] - able to switch to [b]Inverse[/b] fire. The character will fire their gun all the time and only stop when the fire button is held - intended for anyone experiencing discomfort from holding the trigger for long periods

[*]Improvements to gamepad support under Linux, but there are still issues. Logitech gamepads and Dualshock 4's seem to work in SteamOS now but not on other distros, but it's an area we're investigating

notes.title: Early Access Update 17
notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update17.jpg[/img]This has been a big update for us as we upgraded major engine versions and overhauled input handling. A lot has changed under the hood even though our priority was trying to make sure everything kept working the way it has been, with a bunch of smaller improvements.

Unfortunately this means the update has an unusually large download size. Sorry!

If you encounter new problems in terms of how it runs or how controllers function, we ask for your patience and your feedback on the forums as we chase down anything we may have missed.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New input handling[/b] - Joypad support should now be more consistent and better across Windows, OSX and Linux. If you have had controllers that work on your machine but would not work with Cactus, give them another try! Xbox pads can now be used along side non-XInput devices in Windows. If you have controllers that did work, but now do not, please make sure you have current drivers and if it doesn't help, let us know on the forum!
[*]PS3/PS4 controllers that identify themselves will use Playstation style face button prompts
[*][b]Stage Select[/b] - new art and animations
[*][b]Narrative improvements[/b] - the Boss dialogue exchanges have had a pass to refocus the events and storyline
[*]Rebalanced audio across the game, many smaller audio fixups and improvements
[*]Holly, Lemon and Coral appear in the background of the tutorial if they're not actively participating
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Corrected a long standing bug in the Multiplayer code that was causing enemies to spawn too close to players
[*]Fixed an issue with Justice's heads that could end up with their hitbox too low to be hit properly when hit with a shutdown while mid air
[*][strike]Linux machines with Intel integrated videocards now display shadows[/strike] [i]spoke too soon - had to build with an earlier version to get keyboard working again in Linux[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]We don't auto-detect PC performance so graphics settings will default to 'High'. If you notice the game running badly or not looking right, please adjust your Visual Settings manually!
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update17.jpg[/img]This has been a big update for us as we upgraded major engine versions and overhauled input handling. A lot has changed under the hood even though our priority was trying to make sure everything kept working the way it has been, with a bunch of smaller improvements.

Unfortunately this means the update has an unusually large download size. Sorry!

If you encounter new problems in terms of how it runs or how controllers function, we ask for your patience and your feedback on the forums as we chase down anything we may have missed.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New input handling[/b] - Joypad support should now be more consistent and better across Windows, OSX and Linux. If you have had controllers that work on your machine but would not work with Cactus, give them another try! Xbox pads can now be used along side non-XInput devices in Windows. If you have controllers that did work, but now do not, please make sure you have current drivers and if it doesn't help, let us know on the forum!
[*]PS3/PS4 controllers that identify themselves will use Playstation style face button prompts
[*][b]Stage Select[/b] - new art and animations
[*][b]Narrative improvements[/b] - the Boss dialogue exchanges have had a pass to refocus the events and storyline
[*]Rebalanced audio across the game, many smaller audio fixups and improvements
[*]Holly, Lemon and Coral appear in the background of the tutorial if they're not actively participating
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Corrected a long standing bug in the Multiplayer code that was causing enemies to spawn too close to players
[*]Fixed an issue with Justice's heads that could end up with their hitbox too low to be hit properly when hit with a shutdown while mid air
[*][strike]Linux machines with Intel integrated videocards now display shadows[/strike] [i]spoke too soon - had to build with an earlier version to get keyboard working again in Linux[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]We don't auto-detect PC performance so graphics settings will default to 'High'. If you notice the game running badly or not looking right, please adjust your Visual Settings manually!
[/list]

[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update16.jpg[/img]

I'm feeling proud of this update! It fills in the two missing levels from Zone 4 meaning you can now play from the tutorial right up until the last boss before you see a whitebox texture!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Focus[/b] (zone 4 - 3) got an art pass
[*][b]Repeater[/b] (zone 4 - 4) got both an art pass and a substantial rewrite - the panels use a better algorithm to arrange themselves and should result in less cases where the path between you and enemies breaks, and feel more responsive in general
[*]You may be able to get a little deeper in [b]Infinity Drive[/b] now......?
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where failing a level muted the music and left it muted
[*]Fixed an issue where music in Infinity Drive / Daily Drive wasn't getting stepped down towards battery depletion
[*]Fixed bug that was failing to extend the Chain counter when Liquorice enters the battle
[*]Improved issue where some flying enemies could intersect moving walls when shut down
[*]Fixed a bug where Attract Mode would affect the Stage Select position in the campaign
[/list]

If you are experiencing issues with the final wave of the last boss not spawning, please let us know on the forums what OS you're running and if there were any unusual circumstances. It's proving a tricky one to reproduce or squash so any clues are welcome!

notes.title: Early Access Update 13
notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update13.jpg[/img]

Lucky number 13! After the excitement of reaching Alpha, we're back to adding, fixing, improving and generally struggling to finish the game before it finishes us.

This update features the first proper reveal of Zone 4 - among the stars and perched above the Genki Star, Zone 4 is a perilous environment of flimsy surfaces and reconfiguring panels. We also recorded lines for the final boss, Medulla.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Assembly[/b] (zone 4 - 1) stage art
[*][b]Relay[/b] (zone 4 - 2) also gets stage art
[*][b]Medulla[/b] (zone 5 boss) has an in-game voice
[*]Minor Medulla balance changes. Due to this and one of the bug fixes, her leaderboard has been reset
[*][b]Shiitake[/b] has her own Stage Clear animation, so now all the androids have unique Stage Clear anims!
[*]on beating Medulla, you have the option of returning to Stage Select, replaying the stage or rolling credits - this is not how the game will end, but it's a step closer!
[*]added a logo sequence to improve startup responsiveness
[*]the battery shows the text "COLLECT" above it for the first five times it appears. After this it goes back to how it was. Unless you miss a battery, then it totally reminds you again
[*]Tutorial tweaks
[*]Zone 1 skybox upressed
[*]continued sound effect iteration
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed game breaking multiplayer bug that under specific circumstances could cause the spawn system to lock up and be a total jerk about spawning new enemies
[*]fixed a game breaking bug in the Medulla battle that was occurring on specific hardware configurations
[*]fixed bug/exploit where a well placed Shutdown would leave one of Medulla's sub-units in a state of increased damage for the entire phase
[*]fixed cosmetic issue where guns were left floating or sticking out of things on Stage Clear
[*]resolved an issue with the AI. They can now be combined with the First Person EX Mode
[/list]

[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/updateAlpha.jpg[/img]

This major update adds the last two stages of the game (including the final boss) bonus modes and content and many fixes and improvements. With this update we consider Assault Android Cactus to be at Alpha, an important milestone in development!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]new Title music
[*]new Credits music
[*]Zone 4 boss [b]Venom[/b] has intro and outro text dialogue. You may want to replay him to follow the story!
[*]new level [b]Collider[/b] (zone 5 - 4) introducing a mysterious sub-boss!
[*]new whitebox Final Boss - [b]Medulla[/b]
[*]Rebalanced [b]Control[/b] (zone 5 - 2) - as a result, its leaderboard have been reset
[*]new game mechanic - [b]credits[/b]. Earn them by playing to unlock bonus stuff
[*]new feature [b]Codex[/b] - as you progress through the game, unlock entries on characters, enemies and world that Cactus is set in
[*]new feature [b]EX Options[/b] - use credits to purchase cool and/or strange extra gameplay modes
[*]new feature [b]Jukebox[/b]
[*]new feature [b]Sound Test[/b]
[*]audio cues added for full weapon cooldown and when you can't swap to your secondary weapon due to overheat
[*]bosses blink their lights when they talk
[*]Tutorial refinements
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed an issue that was disabling HDR if you set graphics settings to Custom - has a noticeable impact on bloom
[*]improved responsiveness of [b]Daily Drive[/b] stage clear leaderboards and trimmed the opening timing
[*]fixed interface issues related to Character Select and Unlock screens
[*]handled a case where Steam Overlay could cause the game to stay paused
[*]Starch's Micromissiles take in account target size 
[*][b]Spectres[/b] (teleporting enemies) no longer leave thin vertical lines behind if you kill them during a teleport
[*]Leaderboard joypad buttons no longer slightly squished (seriously, this was bugging me so much)
[*]many smaller tweaks and fixes
[/list]

Whew! So this is a pretty big update, the two final levels of the game plus a bunch of new ways to explore the entire game.

To see a full breakdown of the EX Options, [url=http://www.assaultandroidcactus.com/2015/03/assault-android-alpha.html]check our latest Blog Post![/url]

We were getting this question a lot! - people questioned why we were 'pre-alpha' when large portions of the game seem close to complete. For many 'pre-alpha' seems synonymous with 'prototype' or 'broken'.

The simple answer is "Pre-Alpha" and "Alpha" can describe various stages of development but Alpha is "gameplay complete". For Assault Android Cactus to reach Alpha means all characters, levels, weapons, enemies are present and accounted for.

Our next major milestone will be Beta. In the following updates we will be replacing placeholder art, adding missing animations and fleshing out story content and ex modes. Thankyou so much to everyone who as supported us so far and I hope you enjoy the ride as we head for the finish line!

notes.title: Early Access Update 11 - Daily Drive
notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update11.jpg[/img]

This update introduces a new game mode called [b]Daily Drive[/b] - think of it as a short, ten layer version of Infinity Drive that changes every day [i]and you only get one try![/i]

There's a new Leaderboard page (showing the current leaderboard - we will eventually host the archives on our website) and we hope you have fun with it!

[h1]Features/changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]new game mode - [b]Daily Drive[/b]
[*]More generous battery rules in Infinity Drive / Boss Rush - more chance of receiving a battery immediately before a boss and bosses will now always drop a battery on defeat
[*]Justice now charges his plasma field meaning there is a brief window between getting too close to him and taking damage. However he now also uses his plasma field while deploying laser fences and capture spheres
[*]Leaderboards - you can now scroll through your friends list (funny story! When I was writing this feature I didn't have over 15 friends who'd played the game)
[*]Stage Select leaderboards - friends list will frame your score if you're not in the top 5
[*]Dogs that drag you around will break their link if you can break line of sight
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed geometry in Relay where players could end up outside the level
[*]Fixed issue where Venom would teleport to the middle of the stage when shutdown under certain circumstances
[*]Reworked the chain system to remove an ambiguous case where chaining a boss together with an element worth no points would result in a multikill bonus - the rule that both enemies involved must be worth points should now be consistently enforced across all characters/weapons
[*]Venom has a better collision volume during his final phase, resulting in more accurate railgun hits
[*]Android Select doesn't imply you can add another character if you return to it in 4 player mode
[*](Maybe?) fixed the issue with guns ending up in the wrong spot on Stage Clear ... if anyone spots it in the latest build, let us know!
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 10.5
notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update10_5.jpg[/img]

We're still hard at work on the main content of the campaign, this update adds various audio and visual improvements and tuning changes.

[b]Important! We've reenabled SSAO on Highest visual quality. It is an expensive effect and if the game is performing worse after this update, please check out the Video Settings menu.[/b]

[h1]Features/changes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Transit[/b] has received an art pass, [i]Zone 3 no longer has whitebox stages![/i]
[*][b]Venom[/b] has spoken dialogue during his battle
[*][b]Infinity Drive[/b] has had a tuning pass to improve consistency around boss fights and in multiplayer.
[*][b]Infinity Drive[/b] high scores are now driven by Layer Reached, with the score itself only used as a tie breaker. Due to these changes the Infinity Drive leaderboards have been reset.
[*][b]Coral[/b] now has a Stage Clear animation
[*][b]Shiitake[/b]'s mines have received a small damage reduction
[*][b]Lemon[/b]'s rockets have received a small damage increase
[*][b]Holly[/b]'s seeker has received a small damage increase at higher levels
[*][b]Video Settings[/b] menu has been expanded to allow finer control. Effects like bloom, reflections and image processing can now be toggled on and off directly.
[*][b]SSAO[/b] re-added with three levels of quality
[*][b]Colour correction[/b] added
[*][b]FXAA anti-aliasing[/b] added (off by default)
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked spawn system - dissolving robots should no longer pop out of existence during heavy action
[*][b]Wasps[/b] apply damage correctly - previously they were slightly inconsistent
[*][b]Vespula[/b] now summons wasps in a pretty, non-arbitrary pattern
[*]Fixed Shiitake's railgun not hitting Venom's arms when you were super close
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]When starting the game with "-popupwindow" in order to play in full screen windowed mode (in Windows) you will not be able to set the game to fullscreen mode, but the options menu does not reflect this
[*]Native Dual Shock 3 support in OSX is busted. It is possible to work around it using a control remapper that makes the DS3 to emulate an xbox pad or similar, and we are working on a proper fix
[*]Shadows are missing on certain integrated videocards under Linux
[*]Native Steam Controller support still coming soon
[*]Aubergine's singularity effect looks different on Linux. Functionality is fine, it's just distorting the screen in the wrong direction. Been tricky to figure out...
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 9 - Venom and Peanut
notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update9.jpg[/img]

It has been a while coming, but we've we're happy to be adding the fourth boss to our game, Venom, along with our eighth and final playable character, Peanut.

As per our usual pattern, Venom is unfinished - he lacks final art, dialogue and effects, and while we have prioritised getting his gameplay to a good place, his balance and difficulty are still being assessed, so let us know what you think on the Steam forums! (Venom is currently not part of Boss Rush)

He does however have a totally awesome themesong, so be sure to set the music volume up and play him with headphones!

We also hope you all like Peanut - she has a distinctive playstyle that might take a little getting used to, but we're looking forwards to seeing what the community makes of her!

[h1]Features/changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]New whitebox Zone 4 Boss - [b]Venom[/b]
[*]New playable character - [b]Peanut[/b] - she can be unlocked by defeating Venom
[*][b]Justice[/b] (zone 3 boss) has been tuned slightly easier in his first two phases
[*][b]Focus[/b] (zone 4 - 3) has been rebalanced to be more challenging
[*]Added a new command line argument, "-safe". This will force AAC to start in 640x480 windowed resolution and can be used to recover in case the game gets stuck in an unsupported resolution. This is a workaround until we can better detect/prevent this case!
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed glitch with Aubergine's singularity that was reducing it's intended impact damage
[*]Fixed Coral's plasma field lightning effect
[*]Fixed Starch's micromissile homing algorithm that was very occasionally causing missiles to pick inappropriate targets
[*]Updated XInput drivers
[*]Many many fixes and improvements under the hood
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]When starting the game with "-popupwindow" in order to play in full screen windowed mode (in Windows) you will not be able to set the game to fullscreen mode, but the options menu does not reflect this
[*]Native Dual Shock 3 support in OSX is busted. It is possible to work around it using a control remapper that makes the DS3 to emulate an xbox pad or similar, and we are working on a proper fix
[*]Shadows are missing on certain integrated videocards under Linux
[*]Native Steam Controller support still coming soon
[*]Aubergine's singularity effect looks different on Linux. Functionality is fine, it's just distorting the screen in the wrong direction. Been tricky to figure out...
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]http://www.witchbeam.com.au/sheader/update8.jpg[/img]

We've added the last of our three gameplay modes, [b]Infinity Drive[/b], a long format mode where you take your favourite android and battle through as many layers as you can before your battery gives out. It gets intense and there's some surprises inside so if you think regular Cactus levels are over too soon or you want to kill some time with some friends, be sure to check it out! The stage art is whitebox and there are likely to be some tuning adjustments to be made once we see how people interact with it, but we think it's in a good place and are keen to hear reactions!

We have also added voice acting for the androids! It's been a long time coming and we worked with some very talented people to bring more character to the game!

[*]New game mode - [b]Infinity Drive[/b] - see how far you can get through increasingly challanging waves of enemies (whitebox)

[*]Pressing Y (on game controller) to locate your character in multiplayer will also make them call their name
[*]updated whitebox level [b]Transit[/b] (world 3 - 2)
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Aubergine's Singularity slows Embryo's movement again and is detached when he relocates
[*]Fixed an issue that was incorrectly forcing lower graphics settings when it got an unexpected value from the videocard. This mostly affected laptops. If the game seems to be running slower than before (but looks better!) reduce the setting to get the same result
[*]Fixed glitch that stopped Kegs playing their Shutdown animation correctly
[*]Fixed glitch that caused Leaderboards to fail to display scores if you had not registered a score on that board yet
[*]Fixed glitch with leaderboards not handling cases when only one or two entries were avaliable to process
[*]Improved wasp behaviour to allow them to get unstuck if they end up on top of things
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update 6!
notes.content:
In this update we are excited to release the third world boss, Justice, and our next playable character, Shiitake!

Justice is work in progress, both him and his stage will see a substantial overhaul then continued refinement over following updates. If you recall the transformation between initial Vespula and her current state, you can expect something similar! Our priority was getting his gameplay to where we wanted it then getting into your hands.

We're now keen to hear feedback, either on the forum or you can contact us directly through email or twitter, although if you do get stuck on Justice, please give him another go with different characters and try varying your tactics! We want to hear about initial frustrations, but it's more constructive if it's in the context of having seen his entire battle.

We are also very much looking forwards to hearing peoples impressions of Shiitake. She's not as unorthodox as Aubergine, but still has her own tactics and strengths and we'll be paying close attention to how well she integrates into the game!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]New whitebox World 3 Boss - [b]Justice[/b]
[*]New playable character - [b]Shiitake[/b] - she can be unlocked by defeating Justice
[*]new visuals for [b]Centrifuge[/b] (world 5 - 1) with rebalanced enemies - as a result the leaderboard has been reset
[*][b]Aubergine[/b]'s singularity has had a minor damage increase and when using mouse and keyboard, Helo now controls cursor relative.
[*]Tutorial support for up to four players - starting a game with cleared settings will now ask you to confirm players before progressing to the tutorial. The tutorial can also be played in multiplayer from the Stage Select menu
[*]Rebalanced audio across the game - if the game seems too quiet, check your volume settings. The mix should be more even so you might want to set them back to default
[*]hitting Y / top button on a gamepad during multiplayer will indicate your character
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance improvements and reduced spikes during gameplay
[*]Improved visual tell on lasso dogs
[*]Improved enemy pathfinding on [b]Repeater[/b]
[*]Fixed some effects that weren't firing when they should
[*]Fixed formatting errors on the leaderboard and clear screen
[*]Audio walls in World 3 now simulate a pattern when music is disabled
[*]Many many small fixes
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]When starting the game with "-popupwindow" in order to play in full screen windowed mode (in Windows) you will not be able to set the game to fullscreen mode, but the options menu does not reflect this
[*]Native Dual Shock 3 support in OSX is busted. It is possible to work around it using a control remapper that makes the DS3 to emulate an xbox pad or similar, and we are working on a proper fix
[*]Shadows are missing on certain integrated videocards under Linux
[*]Native Steam Controller support still coming soon
[/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Steam leaderboard support! On all levels, scores are uploaded, and will be compared against the global leaderboard on Stage Clear

notes.title: Assault Android Cactus blasts her way onto Early Access!
notes.content:
The three of us here at Witch Beam are extremely pleased to announce that Assault Android Cactus is now available for Early Access!

Our game is still in development and there is plenty of content, features and polish left to go into the game. You will see work in progress content and there may be minor bugs and balance issues. That said, it is still very playable and if you've blazed a path through our demo and just want more, then our Early Access has what you need! It should also be a great experience for anyone who wants to take a peek behind the curtain of how a game like this is built!

And of course it’s a great way to secure the final game and support us during development.

[b][i]Right now[/i][/b], our Early Access build contains
[list]
[*]8 finished levels (including Embryo, zone 1's boss)
[*]8 whitebox levels (including Vespula, zone 2's boss)
[*]5 playable characters (including our first unlock!)
[*]1-4 player local co-op, just grab some friends and gamepads!
[*]competitive score and rank system for all the levels
[/list]
And it'll only get better from here.

We're hard at work integrating Steam Leaderboards, more whitebox levels and the features that will round out the game experience. We're not certain just how frequently we will update, but we have an aggressive schedule and I'm hoping to push out new builds regularly so everyone can follow along with our progress.

We would love to hear your feedback over on our Community Hub and we hope you enjoy the ride!
